_comment: Frozen HK detector description for the WAND production, aligned with the WCSim HK production (WCSim v1.12.34, run_macros/particle_iso_e.mac + tuning_parameters.mac). Pinned so edits to HK_physics_config.json cannot silently change the campaign. Water: WCSim's tables x abwff 1.30 / rayff 0.75, no Mie (materials/water_wcsim.json). QE: WCSim's head-on detection per photon arriving at the PMT (pmt/HK_QE_wcsim.json, front glass included; scripts/make_wcsim_pmt_optics.py), with the glass/cathode rgcff 0.32. Blacksheet: 0.045 x bsrff 2.5 = 0.1125 (WCSim's value up to 395 nm; 0.145 / 0.1375 at 440 / 500 nm), diffuse. Specular fractions sit just inside (0, 1), as the calibration fit (HKUKLI/hk_multiwavelength_job.py) needs for logit(f).

digitizer._note: WCSim SKI digitizer as the HK production macro sets it: DeadTime 560 ns, TimingPrecision 0.1 ns, PEPrecision 0.3; dark rate 4.2 kHz x SetConvert 1.1125 (pulses before the threshold curve, which keeps ~90% of them).

trigger._note: WCSim NDigits as the HK production runs it (HKTrigger defaults): threshold 25 + noise adjustment = 42, window 200 ns, readout -400 / +950 ns.
